name: alsa_rme_adi2_volume_control
description: Control the mute and volume state of an RME ADI-2 device directly in Volumio.
author: Alberto Pettarin

volumio_info.details: This Volumio 4 plugin installs ALSA user-defined control elements (mute/unmute and volume) that Volumio can pilot as an hardware mixer, and a background service that watches them and sends the appropriate MIDI SysEx commands to the attached RME ADI-2 device.
